0022600001.text: Both the Boston Celtics and the Detroit Pistons are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Celtics visiting Detroit. Ten Celtics players are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions: Baylor Scheierman, Derrick White, Devin Carter (illness), Jayson Tatum, Mike Conley, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Paul George, Payton Pritchard, and Sam Hauser (rest for all but Carter). The Celtics lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Boston a 50% chance to win.
